summary: Strategy Inc filed an 8-K on September 24, 2026, disclosing board approval to submit charter amendments for its four preferred series (STRF, STRC, STRK, STRD) to a virtual special meeting on October 28, 2026, with a September 25, 2026 record date. The amendments shift dividend record dates to each calendar day, payable the next business day, without changing total dividend amounts. First daily dividends are expected November 2, 2026 for STRC and January 4, 2027 for STRF, STRK and STRD. This is a routine governance matter, not a special situation; watch stockholder approval and filing effectiveness.
